service.name: APPLIB_RPC_SVC_SHAREPREVIEW

procedure_numbers.init: registration side effect; not RPC proc

service.state_basis: DAT_a1443d18 assignments in init/enable/disable and GetStatus path

config_layout.meaning: RTOS memory pool; must be nonzero
default 2; exact semantic not required for registration
VideoAnal callback selector; default config 2; shell init with no optional args changes it to 0
UpdatePeriod; default config 0; shell init with no optional args changes it to 30; enable rejects zero
frame pitch/width field used by update path; default 1024

init_gates: memory pool and width and height must be nonzero
allocates share buffer of width*height*3 + 0x38 bytes and reader buffer of 8 bytes
attempts to register RPC service only after both allocations succeed
initial status becomes 1 even though the inner service-register return is ignored; state alone is not registration proof
enable_gates: state must be 1; state 0 and state 2 return errors

frame_contract.filter: callback increments a counter; it copies only when input width/height equal configured width/height and counter equals UpdatePeriod
frame_contract.cache_order: invalidate source; copy source to selected shared buffer; clean destination; publish active index and clean 0x38-byte header
frame_contract.ring: three Y buffers; header entries contain pitch,width,height,size; pointer table is at header +0x2c/+0x30/+0x34
frame_contract.reader: 8-byte reader area; its +0x04 value is consulted as reader index

videoanal_callback_registry.slots: 16 callback slots beginning at 0xA14307B8; each slot stride 8, function/event fields are at slot_base+0x1dc/+0x1e0
videoanal_callback_registry.unregister_match: matches both callback pointer and mapped event code before clearing slot

runtime_evidence.rpc_query: program 0x1000000c proc 3 returned service not found

shell_entry.usage: t app test sharepv [init | en | dis]
shell_entry.init_no_optional_args: sets callback selector 0 and UpdatePeriod 30 after default_config
shell_entry.init_optional_args: first optional value is selector and second is UpdatePeriod; width/height remain defaults in this handler

limitations: Function names and structure fields are inferred from disassembly/pseudocode.
The shell command was recovered statically and has not been executed on the device in this round.
No frame timestamp is present in the recovered SharePreview header; frame/gyro alignment remains unresolved.
A service registration contract does not establish that the default callback selector is valid in every video mode.
Disable unregisters only the VideoAnal frame callback; it does not release buffers or unregister the RPC service.
